supplemental_robustness_scenarios.disclaimer: Supplemental benchmark scenarios evaluated independently of the primary frozen test set.

scenarios.name: Benign Shared Infrastructure (Family Device)
scenarios.description: 2 distinct family members transacting normally from shared home hardware.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Relationship alone does not trigger automatic HOLD (Score < 70)
scenarios.observation: Assigned LOW severity (8/100); friction preserved at ALLOW/REVIEW.

scenarios.name: Legitimate Traffic Burst (Flash Sale)
scenarios.description: Sudden volume surge from unlinked, legitimate customers during promotion.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Volume spike without entity linkage remains ALLOW (Score < 40)
scenarios.observation: Assigned LOW severity (12/100); flash sale traffic correctly allowed.

scenarios.name: Individual Suspicious Account
scenarios.description: Single account with extreme velocity but zero graph coordination.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Behavioral detection fires without manufacturing fake graph coordination (g_score=0)
scenarios.observation: Flagged as HIGH (88/100); graph score remained 0.0.

scenarios.name: Coordinated Low-Signal Ring
scenarios.description: 6 synthetic accounts with plausible amounts cycling shared card/hardware in burst.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Graph + Temporal synergy flags ring even with low individual behavioral score
scenarios.observation: Successfully elevated to CRITICAL (94/100) -> Defensive HOLD.

scenarios.name: Gradual Ring Formation
scenarios.description: Progressive multi-account linkage developing over a multi-hour window.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Provides progressive early warning (Score >= 45) before full ring maturity
scenarios.observation: Assigned LOW (46/100); early warning generated during formation.

scenarios.name: Insufficient Evidence & AI Abstention
scenarios.description: Sparse case with 0 evidence items and low confidence (<40%).
scenarios.expected_behavior: AI explainer explicitly abstains (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) without hallucinating
scenarios.observation: Evidence sufficiency: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; safe abstention verified.
